gloss: standing (on a vehicle); riding while standing

definitions.gloss: standing while riding (train, bus, etc.); standing room only
definitions.explanation: Riding a vehicle while standing, typically when all seats are taken. Also refers to areas or tickets designated for standing passengers.

examples.japanese: {満員|まんいん}{電車|でんしゃ}で{立|た}ち{乗|の}りだった。
examples.english: I had to stand on the packed train.

examples.japanese: {立|た}ち{乗|の}り{禁止|きんし}のバスもある。
ラッシュ{時|じ}は{立|た}ち{乗|の}りが{当|あ}たり{前|まえ}だ。
examples.english: Standing during rush hour is normal.

notes:
{立|た}ち{乗|の}り is common vocabulary for public transportation in Japan.

OPPOSITE:
- {座|すわ}り{乗|の}り / {着席|ちゃくせき}{乗車|じょうしゃ}: seated travel

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {立|た}ち{乗|の}り{客|きゃく}: standing passengers
- {立|た}ち{席|せき}: standing room
- {満員|まんいん}{電車|でんしゃ}: packed train

NOTE:
During rush hour ({通勤|つうきん}ラッシュ), trains in major Japanese cities often exceed 150% capacity, making {立|た}ち{乗|の}り unavoidable for most passengers.
